responsibility: Implements a generic dominator-tree walker used by analyses and optimizations that process blocks in dominance order. The `dom_walker` class manages traversal of dominator or postdominator trees, optional reachability tracking via `EDGE_EXECUTABLE`, lazy reverse-postorder sorting of children, propagation of newly discovered unreachability to incoming and outgoing edges, and callback sequencing before and after visiting dominated children so client passes can layer custom per-block behavior on top of a shared traversal engine.
same_name_distinction: Implements the dominator-tree traversal engine itself, including reachability propagation and child ordering during walks; domwalk.h just defines the dom_walker interface and callback contract.
